ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Madhya Pradesh
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,250 transferred directly into the bank accounts of eligible women in Madhya Pradesh for health, nutrition, and economic self-reliance.
exclusions: Unmarried women (except widows, divorcees, and abandoned women)
Families owning more than 5 acres of agricultural land or paying income tax
application_steps: Visit your Gram Panchayat, Ward Office, or designated camp in Madhya Pradesh with your Samagra ID.
Complete live photograph capture and online form entry on cmladlibahna.mp.gov.in.
Collect your printed acknowledgment receipt and track monthly payments online.
